segments.he:
תּוֹרָה קטז
הַנּוֹתֵן צְדָקָה נִצּוֹל מֵעֲבֵרוֹת:
segments.en: Through the revelation that everything is conducted by His will, may He be blessed — and there is no necessity of nature at all — through this fear is made. For then one knows that there is reward and punishment. And it is relevant to fear Him, may He be blessed. But when one falls into heresy — as if everything is conducted according to nature — fear is not relevant — G-d forbid.
